# Project Quill Settings Reference

This document outlines the configurable settings available in Project Quill. Each setting includes its data type, description, and default value.

## Configuration Options

| Setting Name | Data Type | Description | Default Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `accent_color` | Hex Color String | Defines the primary accent color used throughout the user interface for buttons, links, and highlights. | `#1A73E8` |
| `cache_ttl` | Integer (Seconds) | Specifies how long a page remains cached before it is considered stale and requires a refresh from the source. | `90` |
| `retry_delay` | Integer (Seconds) | Determines the wait time before attempting to retry a failed synchronization operation. | `2` |
